Disclaimer* Barratt Redrow PLC 26 October 2026 26 October 2026 Barratt Redrow plc Transaction in Own Shares Barratt Redrow plc, ISIN: GB0000811801 (the "Company", "Barratt Redrow") announces that during the period from 19 October 2026 to 23 October 2026 (the "Disclosure Period") it has purchased for cancellation the following number of ordinary shares of 10 pence each from Barclays Bank plc ("Barclays") as part of its £386 million share repurchase programme announced on 15 July 2026 (the "Programme"). All shares were purchased from Barclays as an "on exchange" transaction subject to the rules of the London Stock Exchange ("LSE"). Following the above purchases and cancellation of the ordinary shares, the Company holds no ordinary shares in treasury and has 1,373,429,320 ordinary shares in issue. The total number of voting rights in the Company is therefore 1,373,429,320.
